introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart. Place your arms at your sides, palms pressing gently into the mat.

Inhale deeply, press through your feet to lift your hips off the floor. Let your chest open and gently draw it toward your chin, creating a natural arch in your back. Keep your shoulders grounded and your gaze upward. 

Hold the pose for a few breaths. With each inhale, lengthen through your spine; with each exhale, relax into the stretch.
name: BRIDGE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominal muscles.
Inhale to lengthen through your spine. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
Lift your one leg up if it's too easy for you.
This is a great exercise to target your legs, core and gluteus.

introduce:
Start in the push-up position, but keep your arms straight. 

Keep your body straight and hold this position as long as you can. 

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.

This exercise strengthens your abdomen and back muscles.
name: STRAIGHT-ARM PLANK

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Put your hands directly underneath your shoulders.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Do not sink your lower back or raise your hips in the air.
Breathe deeply.
Too easy for you? Add weight on your lower back.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This exercise really works on your core and lower back.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your feet together. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together. Let your knees fall comfortably out to the sides, moving them toward the floor. \n\nPlace your hands by your sides or on your belly, and begin to breathe slowly and deeply through your nose. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to allow your knees to sink closer to the floor.
name: LYING BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch in your groin.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your knees down.
Try to let your knees get closer and closer to the floor.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your left hand on your right knee and your right hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the right. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your left arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your right hand on your left knee and your left hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the left. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your right arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce: Lie on your stomach, bend your legs and hold your ankles with your hands. As you exhale, lift your thighs and upper body off the floor. \n\nPull your heels as close as you can to your hips. Hold this position.
name: BOW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise can stretch your entire body and improve your posture.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring your left knee forward, and place your left foot on the outside of your left elbow. Drop your right leg on the ground, and try to sink your hips down. Hold this position.
name: RUNNER'S LUNGE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If it’s too hard for you, place your hands down on the ground or put yoga blocks under your elbows.
Put your front heel directly under your knee.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring your right knee forward, and place your right foot on the outside of your right elbow. Drop your left leg on the ground, and try to sink your hips down. Hold this position.
name: RUNNER'S LUNGE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If it’s too hard for you, place your hands down on the ground or put yoga blocks under your elbows.
Put your front heel directly under your knee.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Take a big step forward with your right foot.

Inhale as you lower your left knee to the mat. Place your hands on the floor on either side of your left foot. Shift your weight backward and straighten your front leg. Exhale as you gently sink your hips towards the floor. 

Hold this position. Allow your body to relax and sink deeper into the stretch with each exhale.
name: EASY KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Take a big step forward with your left foot.

Inhale as you lower your right knee to the mat. Place your hands on the floor on either side of your right foot. Shift your weight backward and straighten your front leg. Exhale as you gently sink your hips towards the floor. 

Hold this position. Allow your body to relax and sink deeper into the stretch with each exhale.
name: EASY KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides. 

As you inhale, lift your head, chest, arms, and legs off the ground, firming your shoulder blades onto your back. Imagine someone grasping your hands, gently pulling you back, to come up higher.

Hold this position. Use the inhale to support the lift of your head, chest, arms, and legs.
name: LOCUST POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your pelvis on the floor when lifting your legs.
Inhale to lift higher. Exhale to release your tension.
This exercise tones your buttocks and strengthens your back muscles.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged and rest your hands on your knees. 

Inhale, lift your gaze and expand your chest. Exhale, round your back, drawing the chin toward the chest.

Repeat the exercise with regular breathing.
name: SEATED CAT COW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
This exercise stretches your chest, back, abdomen and spine.
This exercise helps reduce the tension in your neck, back, and shoulder.
Inhale when you drive your chest out, and exhale when you round your back.

introduce:
Lay prone with your hands under your shoulders and the tops of your feet on the floor. 

Inhale as you press through your hands firmly into the floor. Straighten your arms and lift your chest. Slightly lift your thighs off the ground. Gaze forward or slightly upward.

Hold the position with deep and steady breath. Inhale to expand your chest and lengthen your spine, exhale to soften your shoulders, relax your neck, and keep your arms and core stable.
name: UPWARD FACING DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Rotate your shoulders back and down.
Keep your legs engaged, don\'t slouch them on the floor.
Keep your neck natural, don\'t strain your neck.
This exercise stretches your chest, abdomen, and spine.
This exercise can firm your buttocks and thighs.
Inhale to lift your chest. Exhale to soften your shoulders.

introduce:
Start on all fours. Spread your fingers wide for stability. On an inhale, lift your hips to form an inverted V-shape. Try to keep a soft bend in your knees and press your heels on the floor.

On an inhale, press firmly through your hands. Exhale, lift your left leg straight back in line with your spine without twisting your hips.

Inhale, shift forward into plank, shoulders over wrists, and draw your knee toward your left elbow.

Return and repeat the exercise.
name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG WITH KNEE DRIVES LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale to lift your leg straight back. Inhale to shift forward into plank.
This exercise stretches your full body and helps build your strength.

introduce:
Start on all fours. Spread your fingers wide for stability. On an inhale, lift your hips to form an inverted V-shape. Try to keep a soft bend in your knees and press your heels on the floor.

On an inhale, press firmly through your hands. Exhale, lift your right leg straight back in line with your spine without twisting your hips.

Inhale, shift forward into plank, shoulders over wrists, and draw your knee toward your right elbow.

Return and repeat the exercise.
name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG WITH KNEE DRIVES RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale to lift your leg straight back. Inhale to shift forward into plank.
This exercise stretches your full body and helps build your strength.

introduce: Start on all fours. Exhale as you lift your hips into an inverted ‘V’ shape, and lengthen your spine.\n\nAlternately lift and lower your heels with steady breath.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Keep a steady and even breathing rhythm without holding your breath.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Start in a low lunge with your right knee on the floor. 

Exhale, twist your upper body to the left and extend your arms to the sides. Inhale, bring your hands together into a prayer position at your chest. Press your right elbow against the outside of your left knee. Shift your gaze over your left shoulder.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen the spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
name: REVOLVED CRESCENT LOW LUNGE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Keep your palms at the center of your chest.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips and spine.
This exercise strengthens your quadriceps and glutes.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Start in a low lunge with your left knee on the floor. 

Exhale, twist your upper body to the right and extend your arms to the sides. Inhale, bring your hands together into a prayer position at your chest. Press your left elbow against the outside of your right knee. Shift your gaze over your right shoulder.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen the spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
name: REVOLVED CRESCENT LOW LUNGE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Keep your palms at the center of your chest.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips and spine.
This exercise strengthens your quadriceps and glutes.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Start in a lunge position with your left foot forward and your right knee on the floor. Exhale, tuck your pelvis and sink your hips.

Inhale, raise your arms overhead with your palms facing forward. Draw your lower belly in, and avoid collapsing your lower back. Exhale as you press your hips forward. 

Inhale to lift your chest and gently arch your upper back for a deeper stretch. Exhale, return to the starting position. Repeat the movement.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE WITH CACTUS ARMS LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
Your arms should be in line with your upper body.
This exercise stretches your hips, chest, and belly.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
Inhale to bend your elbows. Exhale to raise your arms up.

introduce:
Start in a lunge position with your right foot forward and your left knee on the floor. Exhale, tuck your pelvis and sink your hips.

Inhale, raise your arms overhead with your palms facing forward. Draw your lower belly in, and avoid collapsing your lower back. Exhale as you press your hips forward.

Inhale to lift your chest and gently arch your upper back for a deeper stretch. Exhale, return to the starting position. Repeat the movement.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE WITH CACTUS ARMS RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Your arms should be in line with your upper body.
This exercise stretches your hips, chest, and belly.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
Inhale to bend your elbows. Exhale to raise your arms up.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended and feet together. Place your arms close to your body and palms facing down.

Exhale, press your elbows and forearms into the floor to lift your head and upper back off the floor. Lower your head backward and rest the crown of your head on the mat.

Hold this position. Inhale to expand your chest, exhale to soften your chest and shoulders.
name: FISH POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Too much pressure on your head or neck? You can put a little more weight on your arms.
This exercise helps ease tensions in your spine and neck.
This exercise opens your chest and strengthens your back and shoulders.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to soften your chest and shoulders.

introduce:
Lay prone with your hands under your shoulders and your knees on the ground. Move your left leg forward and place it next to the outside of your left arm. 

Slide your right leg back and release your back foot. Roll your left foot to the side of your pinky finger. Keep your left ankle and knee in line. 

Twist your chest to the left. Lift your right foot. Grab the outside of your right foot with your left hand and pull your heel toward your glute. 

Shift your weight forward. Turn your gaze over your left shoulder. Hold this position.
name: TWISTED HALF LIZARD POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your left ankle and knee in line.
Breathe regularly.
This pose greatly stretches your tight hips, hip flexors and quadriceps.

introduce:
Lay prone with your hands under your shoulders and your knees on the ground. Move your right leg forward and place it next to the outside of your right arm. 

Slide your left leg back and release your back foot. Roll your right foot to the side of your pinky finger. Keep your right ankle and knee in line. 

Twist your chest to the right. Lift your left foot. Grab the outside of your left foot with your right hand and pull your heel toward your glute. 

Shift your weight forward. Turn your gaze over your right shoulder. Hold this position.
name: TWISTED HALF LIZARD POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your right ankle and knee in line.
Breathe regularly.
This pose greatly stretches your tight hips, hip flexors and quadriceps.

introduce:
Sit on your heels with your knees hip-width apart. 

Take a deep inhale and walk your hands forward, keeping your hips stacked over your knees. Exhale as you lower your chest and forehead toward the mat, and lift your hips stacked above your knees.

Hold this position with slow, steady breaths. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. On each exhale, let your chest sink deeper, releasing the shoulders and upper back.
name: PUPPY DOG POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Inhale to lengthen your spine.  Exhale to sink your chest closer to the mat.
Keep your hips directly above your knees.
This exercise helps stretch your upper body and tight shoulders.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Tuck your toes, straighten your legs and lift your hips up into an upside down 'V' shape. 

Transfer your weight back to your legs. Press your heels on the mat. Grab your right ankle with your left hand. 

Hold for a moment, then switch to the other side.
name: REVOLVED DOWNWARD FACING DOG

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise stretches your full body.

introduce:
Lie face up on the mat. Firm your back into the floor and press your arms into the floor.

Inhale, lift your legs over your head. Exhale, slowly lower your legs over your head and lower your toes toward the floor. Clasp your hands, ground your shoulders. Keep your hips above your shoulders. 

Hold this position. Lengthen your spine on each inhale, and soften deeper into the stretch on each exhale.
name: PLOUGH POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your hips above your shoulders.
Keep your legs straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to soften into the stretch.
This exercise stretches your shoulders and spine.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with legs straight. Extend your left arm out to the side with your palm facing down in line with your shoulder.

Inhale, then exhale as you roll your body to the right. Place your right foot behind your left leg for support. Keep your head slightly lifted, neck in line with the spine.

Hold this position. Inhale to open the chest, exhale to relax into the stretch.
name: OPEN WING POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Inhale to open the chest. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
This pose helps relieve stress and tension throughout your shoulders.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with legs straight. Extend your right arm out to the side with your palm facing down in line with your shoulder.

Inhale, then exhale as you roll your body to the left. Place your left foot behind your right leg for support. Keep your head slightly lifted, neck in line with the spine.

Hold this position. Inhale to open the chest, exhale to relax into the stretch.
name: OPEN WING POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Inhale to open the chest. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
This pose helps relieve stress and tension throughout your shoulders.

introduce:
Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders.

Keep your toes back and your feet and legs relaxed on the ground.

Exhale, push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. As you inhale, return to the start position and repeat.
name: COBRAS

tips.text: Prepare a mat first.
Tighten your abdominals.
Stretch your abdominals as much as you can.
Inhale when you go up, and exhale when you go down.
This is a great exercise to strengthen your back.

introduce:
Start in the plank position with your arms straight. 

Bring your left leg across your body until your left foot is in line with your right hand. 

Rotate your right foot to the right, pressing your heel to the floor. 

Lift your right arm toward the ceiling. Take your gaze to your right hand. Hold this position.
name: FALLEN TRIANGLE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
This pose stretches your chest, legs, and shoulders.

introduce:
Start in the plank position with your arms straight. 

Bring your right leg across your body until your right foot is in line with your left hand. 

Rotate your left foot to the left, pressing your heel to the floor. 

Lift your left arm toward the ceiling. Take your gaze to your left hand. Hold this position.
name: FALLEN TRIANGLE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
This pose stretches your chest, legs, and shoulders.
